caption: Evidence stack and dataset roles. Syn3DWound supplies synthetic RGB/mesh controls; SALVE is used for shape comparison after ground-truth similarity alignment; procedural fixtures support offline routing and staged-plan demonstrations. None establishes independent metric scale or clinical validity.
data_origin: Sealed result summaries and identified local public-data inputs.
limitations: Descriptive evidence only; correlated views/subsets are not independent subjects.
Synthetic mesh-rendered depth is not a physical sensor measurement.
